title: skimmia laureola subsp. lancasteri
intro: Skimmia laureola subsp. lancasteri, commonly known as the Lancaster's Skimmia or Japanese Skimmia, is a plant species within the genus Skimmia. This plant is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally employed in various cultures to treat ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Skimmia laureola subsp. lancasteri include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
